newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - July 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - July 1.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Education Ministry will open 226 schools in different provinces in Saudi Arabia next year.
- Riyadh chamber of commerce offers six projects with a total investment of 50.56 million riyals for women.
- Jeddah mayor says a one billion riyal investment company will soon be formed for the development of Jeddah's corniche.
- Saudi Basic Industries Co leases a platform in Yanbu at a cost of 320 million riyals to handle petrochemicals.
- A Nigerian woman was executed in Saudi Arabia for heroin smuggling.
- Saudi Cairo Bank and United Saudi Commercial Bank approve a merger with a capital of 2.45 billion riyals.
- Saudi Industrial Development Fund extended 11 billion riyals to projects in Saudi Arabia since its establishment.
